questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Personal connection to the destination (heritage / friends there/ etc.)

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg tænkte Heidelberg er en hyggelig, lille studieby som man hurtig kan finde rundt i. Desuden har universitetet et godt ry.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Jeg synes hele processen op til opholdet var ret uoverskueligt, i det man er i kontakt med mange forskellige mennesker. Jeg var altid lidt bange for at overse eller glemme noget, inden jeg tog afsted. I sidste ende fungerede det hele dog fint, selvom informationerne først kommer lidt hen ad vejen.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Ikke så meget. Men jeg var kun i praktik på sygehuset og deltog derfor ikke i kurserne. Informationerne fra afdelingerne var lidt varieret, men det fungerede ok.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Synes det var ret nemt at finde et værelse gennem "WG-gesucht". Begyndte med af søge ca. 2 måneder inden jeg tog afsted.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Jeg var meget glad for at bo i et hyggeligt lille bofællesskab, som gjorde, at jeg ikke følte mig så ensomt. Men det er klart dyrere end at bo på kollegie.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg søgte også et værelse gennem Studierendenwerk, men fik først tilbudt værelset et par uger inden jeg tog afsted og der havde jeg så i mellemtiden selv fundet et WG værelse gennem WG-gesucht. Men tror at chancerne for at få et kollegieværelse via Studierendenwerk er ret gode, hvis man er hurtig til at søge.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Synes det var lidt uoverskueligt, men de er gode til at sende en mail, når man har glemt noget.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Jeg kan ikke huske så meget, men skulle jo heller ikke vælge kurser osv.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Da jeg blev i tvivl skrev jeg en mail til dem.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Har været i praktik, så skulle ikke vælge kurser.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Spørg universitetet, hvis man bliver i tvivl.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Ikke relevant, har ikke taget kurser

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: På hospitalet har det varieret meget fra afdeling til afdeling, hvor meget fokus der er på de studerende. Der har været afdelinger, hvor jeg kun har taget blodprøver og hjulpet i de daglige arbejdsopgaver uden at lære det store, og hvor man som studerende ikke fik særlig meget opmærksomhed. Synes også det var lidt ærgerligt at vi ikke fik adgang til computersystemerne. Som altid er det meget afhængig af afdelingerne og de læger man følges med. Mit generelle indtryk er dog, at der var lidt mere pres på og der derfor ikke var så meget overskud til læring. Man skal selv være god til at stille spørgsmål og opsøge læringen. Men jeg har alligevel lært meget om sundheds systemet og er de forskelle der er ift. Danmark

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Praktik på hospitalet

questions.answer: Semester bidrag til Studierendenwerk. De har dog mange gode tilbud til de studerende (bl.a. billig mad i mensa), så synes det er pengene værd

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Jeg har ikke deltaget i tilbud fra universitetet. Men har hørt at der findes mange gode tilbud.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Erasmus student network (ESN) tilbyder mange forskellige events, hvor man kan lære de andre erasmus studerende at kende

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Ligge på Neckarwiese, tag på vandreture i de omkringliggende skove, spis en masse Käsespätzle, nyd det sydeuropæiske flair i Altstadt

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Jeg har selv tyske rødder og kender derfor til kulturen. Har dog været overrasket over kulturen på sygehuset.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Prøv at sige ja til så mange ting som muligt. Prøv at tale til nogen på en bare eller lignene. Min oplevelse er, at de tyske studerende er mere åben end vi er i Danmark.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Kulturen på hospitalet. En mere skrap tone og tydeligere hieraki.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Jeg er hurtigt faldet i snak med en masse mennesker og føler det er ret nemt at komme i kontakt med andre.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Nyd og prioriter din fritid. Det er det du kommer til at huske, når du tager hjem igen
2. Selve processen op til opholdet har været ret tidskrævende og bøvlet, men det er det værd 
3. Prøv at komme i kontakt med andre studerende. Hvis ikke det lykkedes med de lokale studerende, så tag til ESN events, der er der en masse søde og sociale mennesker :)

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Den professionelle tone kan nogle gange være lidt skrap, men man skal ikke tage det personligt.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At finde nye venner, som jeg forhåbentlig kommer til at ha' resten af mit liv. At få en pause fra ens travle hverdag

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At føle mig lidt overset på hospitalet.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
